units.source_text: 二女公子亲切地和浮舟谈话，对她说道：

en.t: The Second Princess spoke kindly with Ukifune and said to her:

units.source_text: “请你不要因为这里和你自己家里不同而局促不安。

en.t: Please do not feel constrained or uneasy just because this place is different from your own home.

units.source_text: 我们的大姐故世之后，我一直想念，无时或忘，实在不胜悲伤。

en.t: Since our elder sister passed away, I have thought of her constantly and never forgotten her for a moment; my grief is truly beyond bearing.

units.source_text: 我身又多苦恨，寂寞无聊地在世度日。

en.t: I myself have known many sorrows and resentments, and have passed my days in this world lonely and joyless.

units.source_text: 现在看见你相貌酷肖大姐，觉得非常可亲，心中十分快慰。

en.t: Now, seeing how closely your face resembles our elder sister's, I feel you are very dear to me, and my heart is greatly comforted.

units.source_text: 我身在世间更无亲人，你倘能用大姐那样的心情来爱我，我真是不胜欣幸了。”

en.t: I have no other close kin left in this world, so if you could love me with the same feeling my elder sister had, I would be happier than I can say.

units.source_text: 但浮舟因为惊魂未定，又因为犹有乡村鄙气，所以不知怎样回答才好。

en.t: But Ukifune was still shaken, and because she still had something of a rustic awkwardness about her, she did not know how best to reply.

units.source_text: 她只是说道：“多年以来常叹姐姐和我遥隔山川，现在能够拜见，心中喜慰万分。”

en.t: She merely said, "For many years I often lamented that my sister and I were separated by mountains and rivers; now that I can meet you, my heart is filled with joy and comfort."

units.source_text: 说时声音非常娇嫩。

en.t: As she spoke, her voice was exceedingly delicate and tender.

units.source_text: 二女公子拿出些画册来给她看，叫右近诵读画中的文字，两人一同欣赏。

en.t: The Second Princess brought out some illustrated albums to show her, had Ukon read aloud the words written in the pictures, and the two enjoyed them together.

units.source_text: 浮舟和二女公子相向而坐，不再怕羞，只管专心看画。

en.t: Ukifune sat facing the Second Princess, no longer shy, and simply looked intently at the pictures.

units.source_text: 二女公子细看她映着灯光的容貌，觉得毫无缺点可指，简直十全其美。

en.t: The Second Princess carefully studied Ukifune's face in the lamplight and felt there was not a flaw to be found; she was almost perfectly beautiful.

units.source_text: 那额角眼梢充满秀气，和大女公子完全相似。

en.t: Her forehead and the corners of her eyes were full of grace, exactly like the Elder Princess.

units.source_text: 她看着浮舟，只管思念姐姐，更没心情看画册了。

en.t: As she looked at Ukifune, she could only think of her elder sister and no longer had any heart for the albums.

units.source_text: 她想：“唉，这个人的相貌真可爱啊！

en.t: She thought, "Ah, how lovely this person's face is!

units.source_text: 怎么会这样酷肖姐姐呢？

en.t: How can she resemble my elder sister so closely?

units.source_text: 她又很肖似父亲。

en.t: She also looks very much like Father.

units.source_text: 曾闻几个老侍女说：姐姐相貌像父亲，我相貌像母亲。

en.t: I once heard several old gentlewomen say that my sister's face resembled Father's, while mine resembled Mother's.

units.source_text: 面貌相似的人，看了怪可亲爱。”

en.t: When one sees someone with a similar face, they seem strangely dear and lovable."

units.source_text: 她拿浮舟来比拟父亲和姐姐，不禁流下泪来。

en.t: Comparing Ukifune with her father and her elder sister, she could not help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 又想：“姐姐的姿态无限端庄高贵，一方面又亲切和爱，有过分温柔优雅之感。

en.t: Then she thought, "My sister's bearing was infinitely dignified and noble, yet at the same time kind and affectionate, with an almost excessive softness and elegance.

units.source_text: 这浮舟呢，想是举止还带稚气、万事小心翼翼之故吧，在艳丽这点上不及姐姐。

en.t: As for this Ukifune, perhaps because her manners are still somewhat childish and she is cautious in everything, she does not equal my sister in radiant charm.

units.source_text: 此人倘能再添一些安详稳重之相，做薰大将的配偶也当之无愧了。”

en.t: If she could gain a little more calmness and composure, she would be entirely worthy of becoming General Kaoru's wife."

units.source_text: 她用做姐姐的心情来替浮舟打算。

en.t: With the feelings of an elder sister, she considered what might be best for Ukifune.
